history.summary: Best haul in a month. New search angles (tier-2 local-language networks, publisher-forum chatter, B2B databases, Affilitizer-style program-to-network maps, conference exhibitor lists) broke the plateau. 62 subagents: 90 raw -> 45 unique -> 6 verified. Vlad approved 5 (Connexity dropped — requires an owned landing/comparison site, not direct-linking). PL + DE carried the round; Spain came back empty again (its retail runs on networks already on our roster).

affiliate_networks.name: MCANISM
affiliate_networks.description: German (Hamburg) open CPS/CPA affiliate network on the proprietary Skynet platform. 3,577 programs, 2,000+ partners, OMR 4.7/5 (56 reviews), Shopify partnership (Nov 2025). Paid-media traffic explicitly accepted. Payouts 2x/month, EUR50 min. CAVEATS: one detailed EUR1,700 unpaid-publisher Trustpilot complaint on a thin review base (start small, verify first payment cycle); catalog contains some China-DTC programs (ZAPAKA etc.) — work DACH-brand supply only.

affiliate_networks.name: Performers
affiliate_networks.description: Independent Polish open affiliate network (Warsaw). Publisher self-registration (no contract), curated advertiser roster, ecommerce-first. Audited 24.6M PLN 2023 revenue, profitable, good publisher reputation (make-cash.pl), fast invoiced payouts. CAVEAT: publisher page markets to content/social publishers — confirm paid-traffic acceptance with AM at signup.

affiliate_networks.name: INIS
affiliate_networks.description: Polish open affiliate network (INIS Affiliation), part of Warsaw-Stock-Exchange-listed Digitree Group. ~100 managed partner programs/month, ecommerce/retail CPS (fashion, health & beauty) plus finance/telco leadgen. Strongest solvency signal of the PL trio, zero complaint history EN/PL. CAVEAT: modest scale, email-marketing-heavy parent — small test onboarding first.
affiliate_networks.source: inis.pl + Digitree Group S.A. (WSE) filings + clean EN/PL complaint search

CAVEAT: historically finance-first per independent PL reviews — cherry-pick the retail campaigns.
affiliate_networks.source: leadstar.pl homepage + Jan 2026 PL review + Scam Detector + AJA Media Group record

Weekly payouts, EUR10 min, bank/PayPal, 20-25% network fee. CAVEAT: ~5-person shop, 3.11/5 VermarkterCheck, no known brands, 40% non-shopping — use as capped-exposure SuperClix-class supplement, not a pillar.

history.summary: Two more multi-agent rounds chasing the operator's '8 networks, 2 per company' goal. Round 3 (widened GEO): 58 raw -> 34 unique -> 3 kept (all secondary: Partner-ads DK, Convertiser PL, Salestring DK). Operator then narrowed to EXACTLY 5 geos: US/UK/DE/PL/ES. Round 4 (5-geo, PL+ES weighted): 46 raw -> 18 unique -> 2 distinct kept (NetSalesMedia PL, The Affiliate Gateway UK; NetSales Network dropped as merged duplicate). Across all 4 rounds (~170 subagents, ~6M tokens) the conclusion is firm: net-new OPEN ecommerce CPS networks in US/UK/DE/ES are exhausted (every major is already on the roster); PL is the only fresh vein. Vlad approved 3.

affiliate_networks.name: NetSalesMedia
affiliate_networks.description: Polish open affiliate network (Cube Group). 20,000+ publishers, deep ecommerce supply incl. Empik, MediaMarkt, Saturn, Tchibo, Nexterio. Paid-media buyers explicitly allowed. Clean payment reputation. Strongest find of the batch.

affiliate_networks.description: One of the two largest open Polish affiliate networks. ~80 campaigns incl. top-15 PL ecommerce stores. Self-service, usable by media buyers. Verticals: fashion, electronics, sports & outdoors, home & garden, general merchandise. Minor payout-delay grumbles only.
affiliate_networks.source: Convertiser help center + make-cash.pl + properad.pl + affilitizer (carried from 2026-06-21 round)

affiliate_networks.name: The Affiliate Gateway (TAG)
affiliate_networks.description: Open UK performance affiliate network (Collinson Group), 10+ years, last-click CPS/CPA, self-serve onboarding with express payments. CAVEAT: center of gravity has drifted toward APAC/SEA/Australia — confirm current UK retail merchant depth before scaling. Low confidence on UK strength.

dropped: Partner-ads (DK) + Salestring (DK) — fell outside the 5-geo focus (US/UK/DE/PL/ES) after Vlad narrowed it
NetSales Network — merged duplicate of NetSalesMedia (dead URL, same supply)
history.conclusion: US/UK/DE/ES open-network pool is exhausted vs the mature roster; PL is the only productive vein. To reach '8 / 2-per-company' the operator must relax a hard filter (add geos, allow creator/cashback) or re-activate existing Not-Approved/Suspended networks.

history.summary: Tommy ran a two-round multi-agent workflow (~69 subagents, ~2.4M tokens). Round 1 (US/UK/DE ecom CPS/CPA): 51 raw -> 24 unique -> 23 verified -> 4 kept (retailAds, MagicLinks, Paid on Results, PartnerBoost). Round 2 (open-network only; no creator-first, no China-DTC-hybrid): 39 raw -> 15 unique -> 1 viable (Effiliation, GEO-mismatch but Vlad approved). Vlad approved 3, rejected MagicLinks (creator-first, same as LTK/Mavely) and PartnerBoost (tried before, didn't work). Conclusion: net-new US/UK/DE OPEN ecommerce CPS pool is largely exhausted after a very mature roster.
